# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 7 years old  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolboy  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome child with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose and is noted for having a dimple in one of his cheeks while lacking one in the other.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a lively and mischievous youth who possesses a strong sense of curiosity. Highly inquisitive, he frequently asks challenging questions and exhibits a practical mindset that lacks imaginative inclination. Though he works with great energy and zeal, he is often heedless and forgetful in his actions. His future ambition is to become a storekeeper so he can have access to abundance of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +4 more_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), are brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) following their mother's funeral, having had no previous upbringing due to his mother's long illness after his father's death as a baby. Davy rapidly establishes himself as a handful through mischief, such as dropping a caterpillar down a churchgoer's dress, tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. He is eventually caught locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lying about it, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to give him a heart-to-heart talk about the seriousness of dishonesty. Though Davy continues to cause accidental chaos—such as destroying Anne's lemon pies meant for a guest—he develops a close bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), often chatting with her before bed and showing jealousy when she spends time with other children. During a school day, he engages in classroom antics that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) must manage, and he regularly displays poor table manners. When the twins' uncle passes away, he leaves them trust money, ensuring that Davy and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently. Davy later participates in the household life by sharing local gossip about neighbors and recounting stories about his classmates during meals.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), +474 more_

## Quotes

> "You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ‘s old as me?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "You was a girl once, I s’pose, though it’s awful funny to think of it. Dora can sit still . . . but there ain’t much fun in it I don’t think. Seems to me it must be slow to be a girl. Here, Dora, let me liven you up a bit."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)

> "Marilla washed it yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scoured me with hard soap the day of the funeral. That’s enough for one week. I don’t see the good of being so awful clean. It’s lots more comfable being dirty."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "But it was such a jolly big caterpillar . . . I picked him up on the church steps just as we went in. It seemed a pity to waste him. And say, wasn’t it fun to hear that girl yell?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy comes under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's care as her student and household companion after being brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though Davy frequently causes trouble with misbehavior—such as lying or hiding a toad in Marilla's bed—[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) patiently counsels him on morality and covers for his pranks when he promises to reform. Despite his mischievous antics, Davy forms a fond bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who helps manage his discipline alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

- Friend of — fond companion  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>
- Student of  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, who arrived with him at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following their mother's funeral. Davy often targets [Dora](../character/dora.md) with his mischievous pranks, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen and locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. Despite his frequent teasing and occasional bouts of jealousy, the two remain close siblings sharing daily life and outings together.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +8 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) took Davy and his twin sister into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following their mother's death. Davy's frequent mischievous pranks—including putting a toad in her bed and causing scenes at church—present a continuous disciplinary challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Although she finds herself dealing with his constant antics, she works together with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to figure out how best to raise and guide him.

- Serves under  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P58](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0058)</sub>
